user.title: Connect to Jackery Home Cloud
user.description: Enter your Jackery Home Cloud credentials.

systems.title: Select systems and MQTT options
systems.description: Choose which systems should be added to Home Assistant and configure optional MQTT connection settings.

data.mqtt_tls_insecure: Ignore invalid / expired MQTT TLS certificates

data_description.mqtt_poll_interval: How often to actively request fresh live MQTT power/SOC/AC-output values. Between 5 and 60 seconds, default 60. Cumulative energy totals use a separate, slower poll cycle. Shorter intervals increase MQTT traffic load on your broker/network.

mqtt_system.title: Select the MQTT system
mqtt_system.description: Multiple systems were identified in the Jackery account. Choose which one should receive MQTT telemetry and controls; the other selected systems remain REST-only.

data_description.mqtt_system_id: Currently, only one system can be connected to the Jackery MQTT broker.
